title: Music Row Stay – 8 Mins to Broadway/Free Parking-1
description:
Walk to nearby restaurants, bars and iconic music studios ON MUSIC ROW! Enjoy free parking convenience in the heart of the country music legacy. Vanderbilt and Belmont Universities are walking distance away!
Explore Nashville's heartbeat at our Music Row gem! Fully renovated unit merging classic charm with modern vibes.
* 1.8 miles from downtown Nashville
* 0.8 miles from Vanderbilt Hospital
* 4.2 miles from Nissan Stadium
*1.5 miles from The Gulch

The space
KEY FEATURES:
✔ Sleeps 6 comfortably
✔ 2 Bedrooms (1 King, 1 Queen) + Sleeper Sofa
✔ 1 Full Bathroom w/ walk-in shower
✔ Modern kitchen w/ dining for 6
✔ 2-Gig Fiber WiFi + YouTube TV (stream with your logins)
✔ Blackout curtains in every room
✔ Washer + Dryer (detergent included)
✔ 2 FREE parking spots + weekend street parking

Here Are A Few Kind Words From Past Guests:

o “For someone who was born in Tennessee as myself. I can say she absolutely brought out the Tennessee charm with her property! The place was beautiful. We enjoyed every minute of our stay! Brianna was amazing! She responded immediately and was very helpful. Thank you Brianna!” -Scott
o “What an amazing spot on historic Music Row! Thanks Brianna for hosting our wonderful stay. Can’t wait to book this spot again!” – Henry
o “Such a beautiful place!! Everything was spotless and clean. Very close to all the attractions and restaurants. Would highly recommend and would be booking this place again.” -Chey

💫 Ready to Book?

Whether you're visiting for a concert, college tour, or just soaking in Nashville vibes, this Music Row gem is the perfect home base. Book your stay now and let us take care of the rest.

Guest access
Self-check-in with keyless electric lock codes, to ensure safety for all guests. Full access to the entire unit, no shared spaces within the unit. Guests will also have access to 2 free parking spaces behind the building. Additional street parking in front of the building is free on the weekends. If you have issues with parking, just let us know!
